Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that streams audio chunks from an async source using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import asyncio
import websockets
import json
import os
from typing import AsyncGenerator

async def stream_speech_to_text() -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    # Using OpenAI Whisper API for streaming speech-to-text
    # This requires setting OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable
    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable is required")
    
    # Connect to OpenAI's real-time audio streaming endpoint
    uri = "wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime"
    
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "OpenAI-Beta": "realtime=v1"
    }
    
    async with websockets.connect(uri, extra_headers=headers) as websocket:
        # Send initial session configuration
        await websocket.send(json.dumps({
            "type": "session.update",
            "session": {
                "model": "gpt-4o-realtime-preview-2024-12-17",
                "modalities": ["text", "audio"],
                "voice": "alloy",
                "input_audio_format": "pcm_16",
                "output_audio_format": "pcm_16"
            }
        }))
        
        # Listen for transcriptions
        async for message in websocket:
            data = json.loads(message)
            if data.get("type") == "response.text.delta":
                yield data.get("delta", "")

# Example usage would be:
# async def main():
#     async for transcription in stream_speech_to_text():
#         print(transcription, end="", flush=True)
#
# asyncio.run(main())
```
